ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A portion of a mass spectrum of neon is presented above. Estimate the average mass of naturally occurring atoms of neon, assuming that the height of each line represents the relative amount of each mass.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a mass spectrum of neon: the horizontal axis is mass number, the main spectral line is at mass 20, with a height of about 90%; at mass 21 there is a very small spectral line, about 1%; at mass 22 there is a smaller but obvious spectral line, about 9–10%. The problem states that the spectral line height represents relative abundance, so these relative abundances are used to find the weighted average mass. The estimate is 20(0.90) + 21(0.01) + 22(0.09 to 0.10), and the result is around about 20.2 to 20.3. Based on the estimate that the 22 peak in the figure is slightly close to 10%, the average mass is about 20.3 amu.

raw_record.question_text: A portion of a mass spectrum of neon is presented above. Estimate the average mass of naturally occurring atoms of neon, assuming that the height of each line represents the relative amount of each mass.

method.method_draft: First read the spectrum: the main peak is at mass 20 with about 90% relative amount, the tiny peak is at mass 21 with about 1%, and the peak at mass 22 is about 9–10%. Treat these heights as relative abundances as instructed. Compute the weighted mean, e.g. 20(0.90) + 21(0.01) + 22(0.09) ≈ 20.2, or using a slightly higher estimate for the mass-22 peak gives about 20.3. Report the estimated average mass as approximately 20.3 amu.
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示一个氖的质谱图：横轴是质量数，主要谱线在质量 20 处，高度约为 90%；质量 21 处有很小的谱线，约为 1%；质量 22 处有较小但明显的谱线，约为 9–10%。题目说明谱线高度代表相对含量，因此用这些相对丰度求加权平均质量。估算为 20(0.90) + 21(0.01) + 22(0.09 到 0.10)，结果约在 20.2 到 20.3 附近。按图中 22 峰略接近 10% 的估计，平均质量约为 20.3 amu。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct quantitative route: read approximate isotope masses and relative abundances from the spectrum and compute a weighted mean. It is the natural single solution for this problem.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the mass spectrum to identify the visible neon isotope peaks and estimate their heights: a dominant line at mass 20 with height about 90%, a very small line at mass 21 around 1%, and a smaller line at mass 22 around 9–10%.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the height of each line represents the relative amount of each mass and that the desired quantity is the average mass of naturally occurring neon atoms.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply the weighted-average atomic mass rule: average mass = sum(isotope mass × fractional abundance). Convert percent heights to fractions before multiplying.
